Name: FlowerToad
AnimationNotes: Bloom can sway a few degrees; no Tail group. Four legs use the normal trot.

Name: GoldScorpion
AnimationNotes: Eight visible legs paired into four named trot groups. ClawLeft/ClawRight may open or bob. Tail folds backward in sleep; wag conservatively (large tail).

Name: GoldenGriffin
AnimationNotes: WingLeft/WingRight have folded sleep pivots; flap around local Z. Ground trot remains four legs. Keep golden crest and beak moving with Head.

Name: SkyPegasus
AnimationNotes: WingLeft/WingRight have folded sleep pivots; flap around local Z. Ground trot remains four legs. Halo is a separate group and may bob with Head.

Name: VoidBeast
AnimationNotes: Six eyes use EyeLeft/EyeRight roles; all close together. Tail wag only; crown stays with Head.
